verdict.rationale: Semgrep's API docs landing page offers a direct download of an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (public_v1.openapi.yaml) covering the /api/v1 endpoints. The OpenAPI-driven reference with per-endpoint playgrounds and a versioning and deprecation policy corroborates that the spec is maintained. The probe's 404s were on docs.semgrep.dev guess paths, not the documented semgrep.dev/api/v1 URL, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of fetching the spec at the documented URL; v2 endpoints are only Experimental and not evidenced in the spec.
